text.travel.destination.invalid: That destination cannot be set from here.
text.travel.destination.active: Resolve the current voyage danger before changing course.
text.travel.destination.uneventful: The voyage remains watchful but uneventful.
text.travel.destination.arrival: Jomon reaches {destination} after {duration} measures of travel.
text.travel.boarders.memory: Jomon settled a boarding claim on voyage {voyage}
text.travel.cargo.netting: fitted cargo-rail netting catches the first loose lot
text.travel.cargo.empty: The hold is too bare to yield material cargo.
text.travel.resolve.deck_required: Continue the physical deck action or explicitly withdraw.
text.travel.resolve.obligation_settled: The named obligation was settled before the claimant could present it.
text.travel.result.boarders.counsel: {institution} accepts one recorded obligation; the boarding company breaks off without taking cargo.
text.travel.result.shoal.navigate: Soundings find a slower silt channel; {cost} measured actions preserve the hull.
text.travel.result.shoal.yield: The forced shoal passage scrapes {damage} integrity from the hull.
text.travel.result.driftwood.repel: One rope arrangement catches one wet timber lot{extra} from the broken raft.
text.travel.result.driftwood.yield: The household lets the broken raft pass without claiming its cargo.
text.travel.requirement.inspection: Inspection needs {threshold} institutional trust or one counted paper lot.
text.travel.result.inspection.navigate: Witnessed working claims satisfy the inspection; its memory follows this route.
text.travel.result.inspection.signal: The fitted signal shutter supplies the named visible answer.
text.travel.result.inspection.counsel: The patrol records {payment} credit against its inspection account.
text.travel.resolve.response_invalid: That response lacks the disclosed material or does not address this voyage.
text.travel.result.raiders.repel: readied reach drives the cargo thieves back before they can disengage
text.travel.result.raiders.distract: a material decoy draws the skiffs away from the accountable hold
text.travel.result.raiders.yield: {loss}; the thieves escape without pressing the crew{extra}
text.travel.result.raiders.failure: {loss}; an exposed crew member suffers a cut arm{extra}
text.travel.result.creature.repel: spaced strikes turn the animal from the rudder without pursuit
text.travel.result.creature.evade: the pilot crosses the narrow shoal before the animal can brace
text.travel.result.creature.bait.single: 1 salt-fish lot draws the territorial animal clear
text.travel.result.creature.bait.pair: {required} salt-fish lots draw the territorial pair clear
text.travel.result.creature.failure: the household endures the strike; a timber lot or two health is lost
text.travel.result.lure.anchor: measured anchor chain fixes the real bank while the resonance passes
text.travel.result.lure.counsel: named crew answer one another until the false familiar voices lose force
text.travel.result.lure.navigate: lead line and chart hold a material course through the lure
text.travel.result.lure.signal: ; the shutter answers with Jomon's named signal
text.travel.result.lure.failure: the lure costs six more action-clock measures and leaves the courier disoriented
text.travel.resolve.memory: Jomon resolved a {family} voyage by {response}; success {success}.
text.travel.route.no_leg: No charted leg joins those nodes.
text.travel.variant.shortage-skiffs.name: Shortage skiffs
text.travel.variant.shortage-skiffs.cause: A recorded market shortage gives loose cargo an immediate buyer.
text.travel.variant.shortage-skiffs.effect: A third lot-caller boards; conceding can cost a second lot.
text.travel.variant.shortage-skiffs.counterpl: Repel the staged group, misdirect it, or let fitted rail netting catch the first loss.
text.travel.variant.displaced-pair.name: Displaced breeding pair
text.travel.variant.displaced-pair.cause: Altered aftermath work has shifted a territorial pair into the rudder shoal.
text.travel.variant.displaced-pair.effect: Two animals hold separate deck approaches and bait requires two fish lots.
text.travel.variant.displaced-pair.counterpla: Use spaced reach, pilot the narrow water, or pay the disclosed two-lot bait cost.
text.travel.variant.returning-resonance.name: Returning resonance
text.travel.variant.returning-resonance.cause: A prior answering or Jomon's conspicuous fitted signal gives the mineral echo a remembered pattern.
text.travel.variant.returning-resonance.effec: Signal navigation takes a second action and leaves a named route account.
text.travel.variant.returning-resonance.count: Anchor materially, counsel named crew, or accept the visible signal record.
text.travel.variant.obligation-claim.name: Obligation claim
text.travel.variant.obligation-claim.cause: An unsettled institutional obligation has been sold to a boarding company.
text.travel.variant.obligation-claim.effect: A claimant joins the boarding and offers terms for one cargo claim.
text.travel.variant.obligation-claim.counterp: Take the decks, surrender cargo, or settle one real obligation before boarding.
text.travel.variant.marked-shortage-lot.name: Marked shortage lot
text.travel.variant.marked-shortage-lot.cause: A heavily loaded hold makes one regional shortage worth marking in advance.
text.travel.variant.marked-shortage-lot.effec: The thief targets the most demanded carried commodity and arrives through net drag if fitted.
text.travel.variant.marked-shortage-lot.count: Intercept the physical lot, exploit the fitted net, or abandon the declared claim.
text.travel.variant.crosswind-stay.name: Crosswind stay
text.travel.variant.crosswind-stay.cause: Severe route exposure or present storm weather loads two sides of the upper rig.
text.travel.variant.crosswind-stay.effect: Emergency station work takes an extra exposed action and two supports appear.
text.travel.variant.crosswind-stay.counterpla: Brace either support directly, fit a backstay, or spend the disclosed longer station work.
text.travel.variant.returning-silt-tongue.cau: A previously travelled edge now carries a newly legible deposit across its old sounding.
text.travel.variant.returning-silt-tongue.eff: Careful sounding takes two extra actions; forcing costs one extra hull integrity.
text.travel.variant.returning-silt-tongue.cou: Use keel shoes to recover one measure, accept delay, or accept the disclosed scrape.
text.travel.variant.fire-marked-raft.name: Fire-marked carrier raft
text.travel.variant.fire-marked-raft.cause: A recorded regional fire left charcoal lashed among the drifting timbers.
text.travel.variant.fire-marked-raft.effect: Rope recovery takes one extra action but yields a wet timber lot and a charcoal lot.
text.travel.variant.fire-marked-raft.counterp: Claim both physical lots with rope or leave the dangerous salvage unclaimed.
text.travel.variant.grease-soaked-store.name: Grease-soaked galley store
text.travel.variant.grease-soaked-store.cause: Carried wool or charcoal has trapped lamp grease and sparks beside the galley.
text.travel.variant.grease-soaked-store.effec: A second fire starts and station work takes one extra exposed action.
text.travel.variant.grease-soaked-store.count: Extinguish sparse fires directly or use the fitted cover to recover one action.
text.travel.variant.worked-seam.name: Worked seam reopens
text.travel.variant.worked-seam.cause: Low integrity or a recorded repair loads an older hull seam instead of clean timber.
text.travel.variant.worked-seam.effect: The seam begins wetter and weaker; station work takes an extra exposed action.
text.travel.variant.worked-seam.counterplay: Brace the sparse support, use strainers to recover one action, or repair after passage.
text.travel.variant.thaw-surge.name: Thaw surge
text.travel.variant.thaw-surge.cause: Spring high water or winter ice pressure drives water through more than one opening.
text.travel.variant.thaw-surge.effect: Water enters two places below deck, and emergency work takes one more exposed step.
text.travel.variant.thaw-surge.counterplay: Pump the whole deck, redirect water, or use strainers to save a step of work.
text.travel.variant.counterclaim-inspection.c: An outstanding institution account gives the patrol a second plausible claimant.
text.travel.variant.counterclaim-inspection.e: The patrol demands stronger testimony; a cash settlement now costs three credit.
text.travel.variant.counterclaim-inspection.c: Produce stronger trust, a physical paper lot, the signal shutter, or pay the stated account.
text.travel.echo.shortage-skiffs.title: Hooks remembered at the next mooring
text.travel.echo.shortage-skiffs.consequence: a local cargo thief arrives with one extra supply, but names the marked shortage lot
text.travel.echo.displaced-pair.title: Tracks beside Jomon's wake
text.travel.echo.displaced-pair.consequence: the receiving region records where the displaced pair settled, changing the local count
text.travel.echo.returning-resonance.title: The answer repeated correctly
text.travel.echo.returning-resonance.conseque: two household adults compare the false voice with Jomon's named signal and trust the shared watch
text.travel.echo.obligation-claim.title: The boarding paper comes ashore
text.travel.echo.obligation-claim.consequence: the receiving work account records the settled or refused obligation instead of forgetting it
text.travel.echo.marked-shortage-lot.title: A cut mark on the surviving lot
text.travel.echo.marked-shortage-lot.conseque: the most demanded local cargo gains a witnessed claim, and traders bid with greater confidence
text.travel.echo.crosswind-stay.title: The stay's pale working scar
text.travel.echo.crosswind-stay.consequence: the upper rig keeps a visible repair mark, giving the next storm watch a clearer estimate
text.travel.echo.returning-silt-tongue.title: A second sounding on the old line
text.travel.echo.returning-silt-tongue.conseq: the destination chart gains the new silt note, making the hidden shoal easier to avoid
text.travel.echo.fire-marked-raft.title: Charcoal knots at the landing
text.travel.echo.fire-marked-raft.consequence: the local contact recognises the fire-marked salvage and records its origin
text.travel.echo.grease-soaked-store.title: The scrubbed galley board
text.travel.echo.grease-soaked-store.conseque: the galley retains an inspectable smoke scar and a counted fire-cover drill
text.travel.echo.worked-seam.title: The seam entered in the household share
text.travel.echo.worked-seam.consequence: the carpenter-minded adult records the repair and improves one strained relationship
text.travel.echo.thaw-surge.title: Thaw water in the next account
text.travel.echo.thaw-surge.consequence: the destination receives a visible high-water forecast rather than an untelegraphed penalty
text.travel.echo.counterclaim-inspection.cons: the destination account records who accepted the inspection and adjusts one obligation

text.travel.route.node.reed-anchor.descriptio: sheltered reeds, potable water, little trade

text.travel.route.node.charter-market.descrip: a witnessed landing with cargo buyers
text.travel.route.node.ebb-crossing.name: Ebb Crossing
text.travel.route.node.ebb-crossing.descripti: a fast tidal cut, safest near a turning tide
text.travel.route.node.coast-refuge.name: Coast Refuge
text.travel.route.node.coast-refuge.descripti: stone lee and a repair crane
text.travel.route.node.willow-ferry.name: Willow Ferry
text.travel.route.node.old-lock.name: Old Lock
text.travel.route.node.old-lock.description: damaged gates with a narrow tow
text.travel.route.node.chalk-steps.name: Chalk Steps
text.travel.route.node.storm-post.name: Storm Post
text.travel.route.node.storm-post.description: a staffed signal pole above exposed water
text.travel.calendar.route_note.winter: short light, ice, and cold rigging
text.travel.echo.rival_goal: followed a remembered shortage mark from Jomon's voyage
text.travel.echo.population: a displaced pair now uses a marked outer margin
text.travel.route.preview.moored: Jomon is moored here; choose a connected node to preview a leg.
text.travel.route.preview.contact.none: No settled contact at this mooring.
text.travel.route.stop.guidance: Each accepted service advances only the action clock.
text.travel.route.chart.title: JOMON ROUTE CHART
text.travel.route.chart.guidance: Travel takes the charted time; weather, travellers, or cargo claims may interrupt the passage.
text.travel.route.chart.cancel: Number sets course; Escape keeps the current mooring without time.
